name: SaaS Hive
tagline: SaaS Hive is a trusted discovery and launch platform for AI and SaaS products
description: SaaS Hive is a trusted discovery and launch platform for AI and SaaS products. It connects founders who need visibility with users who need the right tools — in one structured, searchable marketplace. Founders list their products and get permanent, SEO-optimized product pages that rank in search engines and AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Unlike one-day launch platforms, SaaS Hive is built for long-term discoverability. Every product page stays live, indexed, and rankable indefinitely. Eve
